title: Down Dog Session Calories Burned Leaderboard
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=downdog:session calories_burned=*
| stats sum(calories_burned) as total_value, avg(calories_burned) as avg_value by practice_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks practice type values by total and average calories burned across Down Dog session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `calories_burned` values for each Down Dog session event and review total and average calories burned by practice type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total calories burned.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which practice type shows the biggest calories burned numbers in your Down Dog session data.
